repo.description:
### Impact

PKI role field `allowed_ip_sans_cidr` is enforced for API `ip_sans` on `pki/issue/<role>`, but not for IP SANs taken from a CSR on `pki/sign/<role>` when `use_csr_sans=true` (the default).

An authenticated caller with sign permission on a CIDR-restricted role can submit a CSR containing an out-of-range IP SAN and receive a CA-backed certificate that embeds that IP, while the same IP is correctly rejected via `issue` + `ip_sans`.

### Patches

This is patched in OpenBao v2.6.2.
repo.summary: PKI allowed_ip_sans_cidr not enforced for CSR IP SANs when use_csr_sans=true
